rationale: The agent submitted return requests without first confirming the actions with the user, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. It did not clearly authenticate the user beyond an email lookup. It also failed to address the user’s explicit request to refund each order to the opposite payment method—there’s no confirmation that cross-refunds were attempted or possible, nor any handoff to a human or user consent to proceed with original payment methods if cross-refunds were not supported. The final message asserts refund destinations without documented confirmation and after the actions were already executed. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the policy-based pass criteria.
